# Between Two Tombstones

> Between Two Tombstones (Macy's Graveyard Companion) is a free web app for visiting cemeteries. At any cemetery it finds the graves with the most interesting stories, walks you through them as a tour, and tells you how those people lived.

It is an installable progressive web app for phones. There is no account or signup. Photos you take stay on your phone unless you choose "Read with Claude" on a headstone.

## Core capabilities

- **Cemetery tours**: find a cemetery near you or by name, then get a tour of its notable graves ("Greatest hits", "Walk through time", or a walking route once graves are pinned). Each stop is a story card with dates, age, occupations and a Wikipedia summary.
- **Offline tours**: download a tour before you go; it reads without a signal.
- **Stamp Kit**: turn a photo of a headstone into a rubbing, an ink stamp and a postage stamp, on the phone. Real rubbings wear stones down; this needs no contact with the stone.
- **Read with Claude**: an optional transcription of a weathered headstone (names, dates, epitaph, symbols). Unreadable characters are marked [?], never guessed.
- **Spirit box and graveyard games**: a static-and-voices toy that speaks the names of people buried at the cemetery who died at least 75 years ago, plus Tombstone Bingo with the traditional meanings of carved symbols.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Cemetery tour: /cemetery/{Wikidata ID}, for example /cemetery/Q2008469 (Oakland Cemetery, Atlanta) and /cemetery/Q360779 (Sleepy Hollow Cemetery, New York)
- Stamp Kit: /stamp
- Spirit box: /spirit
- Graveyard games: /games
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Data sources and licenses

- Wikidata (CC0): cemeteries, burials, dates, occupations, grave photos.
- Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0): life summaries, credited on every card.
- OpenStreetMap (ODbL, © OpenStreetMap contributors): cemetery outlines, when available.
- Find a Grave: outbound links only, built from the Find a Grave IDs that Wikidata stores. Nothing is scraped.
- Wikimedia Commons: portraits and grave photos, under each file's own license.

## Respect rules

- The spirit box only uses people who died 75 or more years ago.
- Deaths within the last 25 years, or with an unknown date, get a plain card with no spooky effects.
- A first-run card asks visitors to stay on paths, give mourners space, and never take real rubbings.

## Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router) on Vercel
- Anthropic Claude, called only from server routes, for headstone transcription
- No database: tours and pins are kept on the phone

## Origin

Built solo for Hackyard Yard #5 ("Haunted"), October 19–23, 2026.
